primary_metric: MAE mm, equal weight to independent source-frame groups
selection: Finite 18 low-rank settings at 64 pixels, validation h1 frame-macro MAE; ties lexical. Freeze before test. Fixed original primary stays primary. No crop or fusion weight tuning.
uncertainty: 90% empirical residual quantile per model/crop/horizon from train-volcano targets strictly before 2018; evaluated on untouched volcanoes 2019 onward. Descriptive marginal pixel intervals; no exchangeability guarantee.
activity: Independently sourced narrow episodes; all other dates unknown. Retrospective labels for analysis only, never predictors. No classifier without >=20 independent positive episodes with monitored negatives.
preservation: Read previous code/checkpoints only. Compare SHA256 snapshot at completion.
operational_status: Retrospective source-network inversion, as-of availability not demonstrated; LOS sign preserved, not vertical uplift.
zero_encoding: Source has zero-filled water/unsupported cells without explicit mask; conservatively treat exact zero as missing per acquisition (including reference epoch). Never derive predictor support from future maps. Validity is provisional; exact zero real displacements also excluded.
